form.name: Supervised Driving Log (PUB 385A) + Parent or Guardian Certification Form

title: SUPERVISED DRIVING LOG

certification.title: PARENT OR GUARDIAN CERTIFICATION FORM
certification.text: I hereby certify that this minor applicant has completed at least 65 hours of supervised practical driving experience, including (except for a motorcycle permit applicant *) 10 hours of nighttime driving and 5 hours of inclement weather driving. This behind-the-wheel experience was given by a licensed driver(s) 21 years of age or older.

signatures.label: (signature of parent, guardian, person in loco parentis or spouse at least 18 years of age)
(print name as it appears in signature)

notary.title: SIGN IN PRESENCE OF NOTARY, DRIVER LICENSE EXAMINER, END-OF-COURSE SKILL TEST TEACHER, CERTIFIED THIRD PARTY EXAMINER, OR MOTORCYCLE SAFETY INSTRUCTOR
notary.text: SUBSCRIBED AND SWORN TO BEFORE ME: MO. DAY YEAR

certification.extra_text: I hereby certify this minor has printed or viewed educational materials provided on PennDOT's website on the dangers of distracted driving.

unfillable: Weather column on the log is the weather tag; the 5 inclement-weather hours are totalled from LicenseLogger's weather minutes
notes: RoadReady template: 28 rows per page with a TOTAL row; the last page adds GRAND TOTAL.
'Day/Night' is a pair of check boxes on the form; LicenseLogger writes Day, Night or Day + Night.
'Location of Practice' gets the drive's start/end place names; the form's examples are road types (rural, highway).
The log is PUB 385A pages 27-28 (RoadReady template, optional); the certification is the separate DL-180C, reproduced after the log.
DL-180C has no totals boxes; LicenseLogger's computed totals (total, night, weather) appear only in the separate 'Computed by LicenseLogger' box.
